run_port_server: run the port server wrapper script to start a gRPC port server on localhost
start_port_server_function: start the gRPC port server by calling start_port_server which checks for existing instances
check_port_server_version: check the running port server version by querying localhost port 32766 version_number endpoint
stop_port_server: stop the running port server by sending a quitquitquit request to localhost port 32766
review_port_server_startup: review the port server startup logic including version detection and subprocess spawning
